Appearance

Slender with long wavy auburn hair and bright green eyes. Graceful movements suggest elven ancestry. Wine-stained hands of a working vintner.

What We Know

A creative master vintner respected as a voice of reason and compromise. Bridges the gap between traditional and innovative wine-making approaches.

First Impressions

Thoughtful and passionate about her craft — speaks about wine the way poets speak about love.
